proposals.expected_failure_mode: Delay may remain weakly identified (1 week vs nearby values), with timing absorbed by latent/infectious durations; waning may be under-identified in a short series and act as an extra degree of freedom.
proposals.rationale: Primary candidate per feedback: SEIRS supports waning immunity/return-to-susceptible to better accommodate high peakiness and potential multi-wave behavior while keeping a single-channel observation. delayed_I(1) matches plausible admission/reporting lag without adding extra lag mechanisms.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: If hospitalization admissions systematically lag infections, removing delay can shift peaks early and force unrealistic E/I durations to align timing.
proposals.rationale: No-lag SEIRS control to test whether explicit delay is necessary versus being compensated by E/I timescales; retains waning to handle sharp rise/fall without increasing observation complexity.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: Over-lagging can smear peaks and degrade fit around rapid ascent/decline; may be non-identifiable relative to changes in E/I durations.
proposals.rationale: Alternative small lag within allowed set to cover plausible 1–2 week admission delay at weekly resolution while keeping the same parsimonious SEIRS backbone.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: May under-represent multi-wave/peakiness if waning immunity is important; can compensate via parameter shifts that smooth peaks.
proposals.rationale: Baseline continuity with previous best spec; keeps compartment count minimal while retaining the single-channel delayed observation aligned to hospitalization-rate semantics.

proposals.expected_failure_mode: H-state dynamics may be weakly identifiable in a short single-season series; mismatch between modeled H stock and observed weekly admission-rate can cause timing/scale errors and over-parameterization effects.
proposals.rationale: Clean hospitalization-explicit test with direct H observation (no I+H mixing) to align the state with the hospitalization-rate target; minimal added structure beyond what is needed to map to H, consistent with identifiability cautions.
